description:
Health Awareness • Health Camp • Village Upliftment
Our Club together with Rotaract Club of Medicrew (7200 members) successfully executed SAKSHAM GRAM on 4th October 2026 at Gagangiri Ashram School, Palghar. A holistic community development initiative, they successfully reached and tested ‼️ It was a full-day community development initiative aimed at going beyond a health camp and contributing towards the overall health, well-being and development of the village community.
The Health Camp included General examination, Vitals, Haemoglobin and Blood glucose testing, Menstrual Awareness Camp, Hygiene Awareness Camp, Hand Hygiene Awareness Camp, Health Awareness & Preventive Care. Beneficiaries 1300 making it one of our most impactful community interventions.
The project was covered in A P News dated 4th October
Attended by 3 Rotarians ad 15 Rotaractors
Total Project cost: ₹10,702
Beneficiaries 1300
